==Overview==
'''Section I''' is the only section the player will encounter in Legacy versions of the game. It contains the same entities as [[Section M]], with the main diffence being the rooms themselves. Since of the original game not going past this section, this is the farthest section in the legacy modes. [[M-150]] doesn't exist here due to the suggestion being made in renovated.

This section has been reworked into Section M.
